answer: The gate is slow on purpose. Under Brokerage account age with broker attestation, an account with trades spread over years, so an identity only becomes useful after it has existed, been checked, and been renewed on someone else's timetable. An attacker who wants a hundred accounts must wait a hundred times, pay a hundred fees, and keep a hundred records current. The bridge is the waiting period itself. The cedar is the renewal that resets the clock on a lapsed record, and the yarrow is the registry that remembers every name it has ever issued.
